ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Assume that the threshold voltage of the N-channel MOSFET shown in the figure is \(+0.75 \, \text{V}\). Using the shown output characteristics of the MOSFET, what is the voltage gain of the amplifier?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The left circuit is a common-source N-channel MOSFET amplifier, the source is grounded, the drain is connected to VDD = 25 V through RD = 10 kΩ, and output vout is taken from the drain; the gate has a 2 V DC bias with a small signal vin = 2 mV superimposed. The right figure is the output characteristic family of this MOSFET, with the vertical axis IDS(mA), the horizontal axis VDS(V), and the curves labeled VGS = 1 V, 2 V, 3 V, 4 V respectively. Then reason: The DC operating point is determined by the VGS = 2 V curve and the drain load line. The load line is VDS = 25 V - ID(10 kΩ), that is, when ID is expressed in mA, VDS = 25 - 10ID. It intersects the VGS = 2 V curve near the saturation region. Observing the saturation-region curves near this operating point, for every increase of about 1 V in VGS, IDS increases by about 1 mA, so gm ≈ ΔID/ΔVGS ≈ 1 mA/V = 1 mS. The voltage gain of the common-source amplifier is approximately Av ≈ -gm RD = -(1 mS)(10 kΩ) = -10.

Around this operating point, estimate the local vertical spacing between adjacent VGS curves in the saturated region, giving gm = ΔID/ΔVGS ≈ 1 mA/V = 1 mS. Finally compute Av ≈ -gm RD = -(1 mS)(10 kΩ) = -10.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: note the common-source topology and the family of saturated ID-VDS curves labeled by VGS. Use the saturated portions of one or more curves near VGS = 2–4 V to estimate the MOSFET constant K from ID/(VGS - VT)^2, using the plotted ID values and VT = 0.75 V. Evaluate gm at the bias point VGSQ = 2 V: gm = 2K(2 - 0.75), which from the visual fit is about 1 mS. Then combine this with RD = 10 kΩ from the circuit: Av ≈ -gm RD ≈ -10.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是一个 N 沟道 MOSFET 共源放大器。漏极通过电阻 RD=10 kΩ 接到 VDD=25 V，输出 vout 从漏极取出；源极接地；栅极由 2 V 直流偏置叠加一个 vin=2 mV 的小信号驱动。右侧给出了 MOSFET 的输出特性族曲线，纵轴为 IDS(mA)，横轴为 VDS(V)，曲线按 VGS=1 V、2 V、3 V、4 V 标注，并且在较大 VDS 时进入近似饱和的水平段。

再推理：静态栅源电压为 VGSQ=2 V，题给阈值电压 VT=0.75 V，因此过驱动电压为 VOV=VGSQ−VT=2−0.75=1.25 V。按指定方法，用饱和区特性估计平方律常数 K，其中 ID≈K(VGS−VT)^2。从图中 VGS=3 V 和 4 V 附近的饱和电流读数作视觉估计，可得到 K 大约为 0.4 mA/V^2。于是偏置点处的小信号跨导 gm=2K(VGSQ−VT)≈2×0.4 mA/V^2×1.25 V≈1 mA/V=1 mS。共源放大器中源极交流接地，忽略沟道长度调制时电压增益 Av≈−gmRD。代入 RD=10 kΩ，Av≈−(1 mS)(10 kΩ)=−10。因此电压增益约为 −10。
